ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) distribution across the fluke surface with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized motion blur artifacts and water spray; macro-level ratio favors low-intensity pixels significantly.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an acute vertex angle approximately 45-55 degrees; depth is distinct and divides the fluke into two symmetrical lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible across the entire trailing edge; frequent high-amplitude peaks (spires) and valleys (divots) creating a jagged linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward convexity (curved trajectory) from the median notch towards the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.
